full_judgment:
Syed Mahmud Hossain J: This petition for leave to appeal is directed against the judgment and order dated 21.01.2009 passed by a Division Bench of the High Court Division in Civil Revision No. 4555 of 2003 making the rule absolute and reversing those dated 25.09.2003 passed by the District Judge, Comilla in Miscellaneous Appeal No. 07 of 2003 allowing the said appeal and setting aside those dated 14.01.2003 passed by the Joint District Judge, 3rd Court, Comilla in Miscellaneous Pre-emption Case No. 7 of 1976 under section 96 of the State Acquisition and Tenancy Act, 1950 dismissing the same on contest. 

 3. The pre-emptor filed Pre-emption Case No. 7 of 1993 under section 96 of the State Acquisition and Tenancy Act in the Court of the Joint District Judge, 3rd Court, Comilla, seeking pre-emption of the land shown in schedule No.1 to the petition for pre-emption. In that pre-emption petition, she alleged that land of schedule-1 originally belonged to (1) Chand Gazi, (2) Hosenuddin (3) Shamsher Ali. Chand Gazi died leaving behind only son Yeasin who died leaving behind five daughters, the pre-emptor and opposite party Nos. 6 to 9, and two sons, opposite party Nos. 4 and 5. He had another daughter named Mirjan who died during his life time Shamser Ali died leaving behind heirs, opposite party Nos. 10 to 13, and Hosenuddin died leaving behind one son named Nawab Ali, opposite party No.3. In the pre-emption petition, pre-emptor further alleged that she is not only a co-sharer by inheritance but also by purchase, as she purchased some land from Sayedunnessa and Obaidul Hoque by two registered deeds both dated 06.02.1991. Opposite-parties Nos. 14 to 25 are co-sharers by purchase. Opposite-party No. 3 without issuing any notice upon the pre-emptor sold the case land to pre-emptees for a Consideration of Tk. 1,50,000/- by the registered deed dated 04.12.1995. The pre-emptor had no knowledge of this transfer. She came to know of the transfer on 06.12.1995 and after obtaining certified copy thereof on 07.12.1995 has filed this pre-emption case.
